raw_response:
The issuer shows thin operating margins (4%) and low gross margins (6%), indicating vulnerability to economic downturns, while moderate leverage (debt-to-equity ratio ~1.49) and adequate liquidity (current ratio 1.30) suggest some financial flexibility. However, strong net income ($2,906M) and large revenue scale ($34,015M) provide stability, supporting an investment-grade rating. The combination of risks and strengths places it in the BBB category, reflecting adequate capacity to meet financial commitments but with susceptibility to adverse conditions.

DECISION: BBB
